node.statement: Applying lem-compcb-rectangular-product to the compatible pair A,B and using e<=e_as<=e_co gives ||A dot B-AB||<=C_co*e||A||||B||; the triangle inequality and ||AB||<=(1+epsilon)||A||||B|| from the epsilon-Banach-C*-norm axioms therefore give ||A dot B||<=(1+epsilon+C_co*e)||A||||B||.
